rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the suburbs as a general area.

example.english: I didn't want to live too far out in suburbia, so getting into the city would be easier.
example.traditional: 我唔想住得太入郊區，出入市區都方便啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zyu6 dak1 taai3 jap6 gaau1 keoi1 ceot1 jap6 si5 keoi1 dou1 fong1 bin6 di1

rows.note: Use this when “suburbia” focuses specifically on the lifestyle and routines of living in the suburbs rather than the area itself.

example.english: After moving there, I realized how routine life in suburbia can be.
example.traditional: 搬咗去住之後，我先發現市郊生活原來咁規律。
example.jyutping: bun1 zo2 heoi3 zyu6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 sin1 faat3 jin6 si5 gaau1 sang1 wut6 jyun4 loi4 gam3 kwai1 leot6
